depiction.primary_object: credit or payment card with magnetic stripe
modifiers: solid heart badge in bottom right corner
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a cutout badge at bottom right

readings.meaning: charitable donation or giving by card
gift card or loyalty rewards card

ambiguity: Could be read as a browser window or calendar header with a heart if the magnetic stripe is mistaken for a title bar at very small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: charity/donation, gift, loyalty/rewards, health, or favorite/preferred

task_intents: donate to a charity or fundraiser
buy or redeem a gift card
set default or favorite payment card
manage loyalty or rewards card points
use HSA or FSA medical card
set up recurring monthly charitable giving

Use up the remaining $18 on that Target gift card
Set up a $25 monthly recurring donation to Doctors Without Borders
Activate the replacement FSA debit card before Tuesday's dental appointment
Register grocery store loyalty card online so the fuel points count
Check which ones expire this month
Chip in $40 toward the group REI gift card for Mark's retirement before Friday
Submit the Wikipedia and public radio year-end donations before December 31 for the employer match

Update Patreon tier for the history podcast

Write a heartfelt birthday card for Mom

reasoning: A payment card paired with a heart badge clearly represents gift cards, loyalty/rewards cards, charitable donations by card, favorite payment methods, or health spending (HSA/FSA) cards. These are all frequent, concrete personal tasks across finance, shopping, and health, and the heart clearly distinguishes it from a generic credit card icon.
